title: 碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制
summary: 從多型與基板、穿通差排到磊晶放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Polytype and substrate and Threading dislocations to Epitaxy release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 多型與基板 → 差排傳承
stages.titleEn: Polytype and substrate to Dislocation inheritance
stages.description: 把「多型與基板」「偏角與台階」「差排傳承」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Polytype and substrate, Miscut and steps, Dislocation inheritance.

steps.title: 多型與基板：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Polytype and substrate: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking.
steps.instruction: 區分 4H 與其他多型，標記晶向及磊晶面。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish 4H from other polytypes and label orientation/epitaxial face. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同；相同多型仍可能有不同晶面。
steps.observationEn: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking; The same polytype can have different crystal faces.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「多型與基板」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Polytype and substrate diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking.

knowledge.titleEn: Polytype and substrate / Physics and model

knowledge.titleEn: Polytype and substrate / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「多型與基板：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：低表面缺陷計數不能證明體內差排與堆疊錯已排除。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「特殊元件工坊：功率、光電與 MEMS」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「低表面缺陷計數不能證明體內差排與堆疊錯已排除」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Silicon-carbide epitaxy and defect control as the task boundary. After reading “Polytype and substrate: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Low surface-defect count does not exclude bulk dislocations or stacking faults. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Special-device workshop: power, optoelectronics and MEMS”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Silicon-carbide epitaxy and defect control: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Low surface-defect count does not exclude bulk dislocations or stacking faults” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「多型與基板」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Polytype and substrate, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同
只看 Si:C 比就確認多型
認為偏角是可忽略的幾何誤差
optionsEn: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking
Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone
Treating miscut as irrelevant geometric error
quiz.explanation: 化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 多型與基板：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Polytype and substrate: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「多型與基板」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：相同多型仍可能有不同晶面。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Polytype and substrate artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: The same polytype can have different crystal faces. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同；相同多型仍可能有不同晶面。
steps.observationEn: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking; The same polytype can have different crystal faces.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「多型與基板」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「相同多型仍可能有不同晶面」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Polytype and substrate, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "The same polytype can have different crystal faces" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 多型與基板／物理與模型

knowledge.title: 多型與基板／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Polytype and substrate / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」與「化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone" is not equivalent to "Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking"; the control must expose their difference.
